homepage.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about AI image upscaling
homepage.faq1Question: How do I upscale an image without losing quality?
homepage.faq1Answer: Our AI-powered upscaler enlarges images while reconstructing details, edges, and textures. Results depend on the source image and selected model, so inspect the output before using it for a final export.
homepage.faq2Question: What should I look for in an AI image upscaler?
homepage.faq2Answer: Look for output quality on your own images, supported formats and scale factors, clear processing limits, and pricing that matches your workload. MyImageUpscaler is web-based and lets registered users process supported images without installing desktop software.
homepage.faq3Answer: Create an account to see the welcome credit grant available in your region, then upload a supported image and choose an available processing mode. Credit cost depends on the selected processing option.
homepage.faq4Question: Is AI upscaling better than traditional upscaling?
homepage.faq4Answer: AI upscaling can reconstruct details that interpolation-based resizing cannot, but results vary by image and model. Compare the output at the size you plan to use and keep the original file available for reference.

faqItems.question: What image formats are supported?
faqItems.answer: MyImageUpscaler accepts JPEG, PNG, WebP, and HEIC uploads. Available scale factors depend on the processing model and support up to 8x per pass.

faqItems.question: How long does image upscaling take?
faqItems.answer: Processing time varies with the source image, selected model, scale factor, and current service load. The app shows the job state while your image is being processed.

faqItems.question: Is my data safe and private?
faqItems.answer: Uploaded images are handled by the processing workflow described in our privacy policy. Review that policy for the current retention and data-handling terms.

howTo.name: How to Upscale Images with AI
howTo.description: Learn how to enhance image quality and increase photo resolution using our AI-powered image upscaler.

steps.name: Upload your image
steps.text: Click the upload button or drag and drop a JPEG, PNG, WebP, or HEIC image.

steps.name: Select an upscaling factor
steps.text: Choose an available scale factor for the selected processing model. MyImageUpscaler supports up to 8x per pass.

steps.name: AI processes your image
steps.text: The selected model processes your image and reconstructs detail at the requested scale.

steps.name: Download your upscaled image
steps.text: When processing completes, inspect the result and download the enhanced image.
